fullDescription: A high-energy, trust-focused professional branding style guide designed for public figures, political campaigns, or community organizations. It features a bold primary blue (#004a8f), vibrant yellow accents (#fcd53f), and organic green highlights (#28a745). The design uses a combination of 'Montserrat' for heavy, authoritative headers and 'Nunito' for approachable body text. Key visual motifs include stacked multi-layer SVG wave transitions, marker-style highlights, and large-scale bento-style badges. Ideal for service-oriented landing pages, public advocacy, and mission-driven startups.
prompt:
## Resumo
A clean, authoritative, yet friendly branding system utilizing professional blue and yellow, characterized by bold sans-serif typography, organic wavy section dividers, and high-impact badge elements for identity recognition.

## Estilo Visual
Create a visual design system with the following specifications: Colors: Primary Navy (#004a8f), Accent Yellow (#fcd53f), Secondary Green (#28a745), Light Blue BG (#e6f0f9), Neutral BG (#f4f7fa). Typography: Headings in Montserrat (weights: 700, 800, 900), Body in Nunito (weights: 400, 600, 700). Key UI patterns: 1. Text Highlight: Use a yellow pseudo-element rectangle (#fcd53f) behind specific keywords, rotated -2 degrees to look like a marker stroke. 2. Wavy Transitions: Use three-layered SVG paths at the bottom of hero sections in Green, Yellow, and Navy, stacked with slight offsets. 3. Shadow/Depth: Use large soft shadows for white cards (shadow-lg) to create depth on light backgrounds.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Header
A sticky top navigation bar with a height of approx 80px. Left side features a logo stack: Large bold heading text (3xl) with a smaller sub-line, separated from a party logo by a vertical gray divider line. Right side features a two-line slogan in medium blue text, right-aligned, emphasizing a professional mission.

### Hero Section
Background color #e6f0f9. Content area includes a left-aligned text stack with font-weight 900 in #004a8f, font-size 5xl to 7xl. Include a 'Identity Badge': A white card with a thick 8px border-left in #fcd53f, containing the subject name and a large primary ID number in 5xl text. The bottom of the section must feature three overlapping wavy SVG layers in Green, Yellow, and Navy colors.

### About Section
White background with two columns. Left column: Standard long-form copy with font-size 18px in gray-700. Right column: A 2x2 grid of value propositions. Each item has a circular icon container (64px x 64px) using theme colors (Navy, Yellow, Green), a bold heading (xl), and small descriptive text.

### Features or Proposals Section
Background #f4f7fa. Left side features artistic typography: H2 text rotated -3 degrees with keywords underlined using the 'marker-style' highlight. Right side is a vertical list of cards: Circular icon on the left, Title in bold navy, and description in gray text. Spacing between items should be 40px.

### CTA Section
Background #004a8f (Navy). The section is decorated with large, partially hidden circular shapes in Green and Yellow in the bottom-right corner. The layout is a flex row (switching to column on mobile) with a large icon on the left, text in the center, and a rounded-full button in Yellow (#fcd53f) with Navy text on the right. Button should have a hover state of #e5be2d.

### Footer
Clean white background with a top gray border. A 4-column grid layout for legal and contact info. Column 1: Identity/Logo. Column 2: Mission statement with a left navy border. Column 3: Contact/Location icons. Column 4: Administrative/CNPJ details in small text. Ends with a full-width bottom bar in #004a8f with centered white copyright text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Identity Badge Card — A specific UI element used to display a name and a primary number/code.
Style a white container with `border-radius: 0.75rem`, `box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`, and `border-left: 8px solid #fcd53f`. Inside, use a flex layout with a chevron icon separating the Name stack (Montserrat 900) and the primary Number (Montserrat 900, size 3rem, color #004a8f).

### Marker Highlight — A text effect mimicking a highlighter pen.
Create a CSS class `.marker-underline` that adds a pseudo-element `::after`. The pseudo-element should have `content: ''`, `position: absolute`, `bottom: -2px`, `left: 0`, `width: 100%`, `height: 6px`, `background-color: #fcd53f`, `z-index: -1`, and `transform: rotate(-2deg)`.

## Notas Especiais
MUST maintain the high-contrast ratio between Navy and Yellow for all ID elements. DO NOT use generic square borders; use rounded corners (xl) and thick vertical accents for cards. MUST include the SVG wave transitions to separate sections visually. DO NOT use stock icons; use clean, line-based icons (e.g., Lucide) in brand-specific circular containers.

style.description: The style is characterized by geometric boldness and professional vibrancy. Typography pairs 'Montserrat' (Black/900 weight) for powerful statements with 'Nunito' (Regular/Bold) for readability. Color strategy relies on a Deep Navy (#004a8f) foundation, using a bright 'Sunshine' Yellow (#fcd53f) for call-outs and numbers, and a 'Growth' Green (#28a745) for accent shapes. Visual interest is generated through custom SVG wave transitions and marker-style text underlines that imply hand-signed authenticity.
